source_name: Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA) - Trade Information
indicator: National RMG Export Value (USD Billion), Knitwear vs. Woven Breakdown, Share of National Exports
usage_in_project: Used to calibrate macro industry export growth, knitwear-woven structural crossover around FY13-14, and aggregate market share (~1.2%-1.5%) of the 8 synthetic RMG companies.

source_name: Export Promotion Bureau (EPB) Bangladesh - Statistical Data
indicator: Country-wise and Product-wise Apparel Export Statistics (EU, USA, UK, Canada, Non-Traditional Markets)
usage_in_project: Used to parameterize buyer destination countries (EU ~48%, USA ~20%, UK ~11%, Canada ~3.5%, Non-Traditional ~17.5%) and market diversification trends in dim_buyer and fact_sales_order_line.

source_name: Bangladesh Knitwear Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BKMEA)
indicator: Knitwear Sector Capacity, Backward Linkage Spinners/Knitting Ratios, and Narayanganj/Gazipur Cluster Data
usage_in_project: Used to model vertical integration benefits, yarn-to-fabric conversion lead times, and lower import dependency for knitwear vs. woven garment companies.

source_name: Bangladesh Bank - Economic Data & Exchange Rates
indicator: Monthly & Annual BDT/USD Interbank Exchange Rates, Repo Policy Rates, Working Capital Interest Rates
usage_in_project: Used in fact_macro_monthly and transactional currency conversions (69.0 BDT/USD in 2006, controlled crawl to 84.8 in 2020, reserve shock to 110.0 in 2023, crawling peg to 120.0 in 2025).

source_name: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) - Consumer Price Index (CPI) & Industrial Statistics
indicator: Headline CPI Inflation, Industrial Wage Rate Index, Electricity and Gas Tariff Adjustments
usage_in_project: Used to calibrate domestic overhead cost escalation, utility unit price jumps (especially 2022-2024 gas/power tariff hikes), and inflation series in fact_macro_monthly.

source_name: World Bank Open Data - Bangladesh Macroeconomic Indicators
indicator: Annual CPI Inflation (%), GDP Growth, Official Exchange Rate, Global Cotton & Energy Price Indices
usage_in_project: Used as benchmark macro indicators in fact_macro_monthly and to model external demand shocks (2008-09 GFC, 2020 COVID-19 contraction, 2022-23 commodity inflation).

source_name: Ministry of Labour and Employment / Minimum Wage Board Gazette Notifications
indicator: Statutory Minimum Wage Revisions for Garment Sector (Entry-Level & Grade Structure)
usage_in_project: Used to anchor exact statutory minimum wage step changes: BDT 1,662.50 (Nov 2006), BDT 3,000 (Nov 2010), BDT 5,300 (Dec 2013), BDT 8,000 (Dec 2018, S.R.O. No. 345-Law/2018), and BDT 12,500 (Dec 2023).

source_name: Mapped in Bangladesh (MiB) - Centre for Entrepreneurship Development (CED), BRAC University
indicator: Geographic Distribution of Export-Oriented RMG Factories (Gazipur, Dhaka/Savar/Ashulia, Narayanganj, Chattogram), Worker Gender Ratios, Association Affiliation
usage_in_project: Used to distribute the 26 synthetic factories across realistic industrial zones (Gazipur, Savar, Ashulia, Narayanganj, Chattogram, Cumilla, Mymensingh) and model workforce demographics.

source_name: Accord on Fire and Building Safety / RMG Sustainability Council (RSC) & Alliance Reports
indicator: Post-2013 Factory Safety Remediation, Compliance Audits, CAP (Corrective Action Plan) Costs
usage_in_project: Used to model structural compliance cost increases, audit scores, and temporary capacity disruptions following the April 2013 Rana Plaza tragedy.

source_name: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) / BGMEA LEED Green Factory Directory
indicator: LEED Platinum/Gold Certified RMG Factories in Bangladesh, Solar Adoption, ETP & Water Recycling Benchmarks
usage_in_project: Used as qualitative context to model factory modernization, energy efficiency per garment, water withdrawal reduction, and renewable energy share in fact_sustainability_monthly.

source_name: Time and Date / Islamic Foundation Bangladesh Hijri Calendar Archive
indicator: Historical Ramadan, Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha, and National Public Holiday Dates in Bangladesh
usage_in_project: Used to populate exact lunar holiday dates, festival overtime surges, and working-day reductions in dim_date and monthly production capacity.

source_name: Public Corporate Profiles of Leading Bangladesh RMG Groups (DBL, Ha-Meem, Beximco, Pacific Jeans, Envoy, Viyellatex, Urmi, Plummy)
indicator: Qualitative Operating Archetypes (Composite Knit, Woven/Denim, Sweater, Eco-Knit, Multi-Factory Structure)
usage_in_project: Used purely as qualitative archetypes to design the 8 anonymized fictional RMG companies in synthetic_company_profiles.md without attributing any synthetic numbers to real companies.
